global_assumptions: Repo root is /workspace/Reclaim with app code under app/ and docs under docs/.
Supabase is the backend; Expo (Dev Client + EAS) is used for builds.
No big-bang refactors; each phase is strangler-style and independently reversible.
Existing behavior must be preserved unless explicitly stated in a phase’s steps.
global_invariants: Single source of truth for auth session.
UI must not write directly to Supabase (all writes go through repositories/outbox if adopted).
Notifications are controlled by a reconcile loop (no ad-hoc scheduling in screens).
Training/Insights engines are deterministic and explainable with decision traces.
Wearable surfaces are projections of domain state, not duplicated business logic.

phases.name: Persistence seams (StorageAdapter + Mood/Meditation/Sleep/Meds repositories)
phases.why_model: Requires careful multi-file edits across many call sites while preserving runtime behavior; an agent is best for safe, systematic migration using ripgrep-driven discovery.
phases.cursor_prompt:
Goal: Introduce a StorageAdapter seam and domain repositories (Mood, Meditation, Sleep, Meds) and migrate ALL call sites for those domains (bounded) to use repositories. Keep behavior unchanged. Keep Training and Insights OUT OF SCOPE (no call-site migrations), but preserve placeholders if they already exist.

Hard scope boundaries (MANDATORY):
- In scope domains: Mood, Meditation, Sleep, Meds.
- In scope edits: add new files for adapter/repos; update imports/call sites that currently call these domains directly.
- Out of scope: Training domain, Insights domain, any recommendation/engine logic, schema changes, Supabase client, routing/providers, navigation flow, notification scheduling logic beyond simple wrapper delegation.

Do NOT change runtime behavior:
- Preserve query keys, queryFn semantics, ordering, filters, paging, and returned object shapes.
- Repositories must be thin delegators to existing functions (lib/api.ts and related lib/* modules). No refactors.
- No database migrations, no table/column changes, no new network calls.

Exact files to ADD (new):
- app/src/persistence/StorageAdapter.ts
- app/src/persistence/AsyncStorageAdapter.ts
- app/src/persistence/index.ts (exports default adapter instance)
- app/src/data/repositories/MoodRepository.ts
- app/src/data/repositories/MeditationRepository.ts
- app/src/data/repositories/SleepRepository.ts
- app/src/data/repositories/MedsRepository.ts
- app/src/data/repositories/index.ts (exports repo singletons)

Exact files you MAY touch (existing) if and only if required for delegation (keep minimal):
- app/src/lib/api.ts (only to re-export existing functions cleanly if needed; prefer no changes)
- app/src/lib/userSettings.ts (only if it currently reads/writes AsyncStorage directly; migrate to StorageAdapter)
- app/src/lib/notificationPreferences.ts (same rule)
- app/src/lib/sleepSettings.ts (same rule)

Call-site migration rule:
- Update ALL call sites in app/src/** that reference Mood/Meditation/Sleep/Meds functions/settings to use repositories/adapters.
- BUT keep the migration bounded strictly to those domains. If you see Training/Insights references, DO NOT migrate them.

Discovery FIRST (before edits):
1) Identify the canonical underlying functions for each domain.
   Run these and paste results into the PR description / final report:
   - rg -n "listMood|listMoodCheckins|createMood|createMoodCheckin|updateMood|deleteMood" app/src
   - rg -n "listMeditations|createMeditation|updateMeditation|deleteMeditation" app/src
   - rg -n "sleep" app/src/lib app/src/screens app/src/hooks app/src/components
   - rg -n "meds|medication" app/src/lib app/src/screens app/src/hooks app/src/components
   - rg -n "AsyncStorage" app/src
2) If function names differ, DO NOT guess. Adjust repository method names to match actual functions discovered via rg.
3) Produce a bounded call-site list grouped by domain (Mood/Meditation/Sleep/Meds) and file path.

Design (thin seams):
4) StorageAdapter interface:
   - getString(key): Promise<string | null>
   - setString(key, value): Promise<void>
   - remove(key): Promise<void>
   - getJSON<T>(key): Promise<T | null>
   - setJSON(key, value): Promise<void>
   - getBoolean(key): Promise<boolean | null>
   - setBoolean(key, value): Promise<void>
   - (Implementation uses AsyncStorage; JSON helpers are just stringify/parse with try/catch.)
   - Add logging tags: [PERSIST_ADAPTER]

5) Repositories (one per domain):
   - Define an interface and a default implementation that delegates to existing lib functions.
   - Export a singleton per repo from app/src/data/repositories/index.ts.
   - Add logging tags: [REPO_SEAM]

Repository content rules:
- MoodRepository delegates to existing mood functions (whatever is found by rg).
- MeditationRepository delegates to existing meditation functions.
- SleepRepository delegates to existing sleep list/load/write functions and/or settings accessors.
- MedsRepository delegates to existing meds CRUD and/or settings/storage accessors.
- If a domain currently uses local persistence directly (AsyncStorage), route through StorageAdapter but keep keys identical.

6) Migrate call sites:
- Replace direct imports from lib/api.ts (and any lib/*settings that touch AsyncStorage directly) with repository/adapters.
- For react-query, only change queryFn body and imports; keep queryKey unchanged.
- For hooks/utilities, keep function signatures identical; only swap internals.
- Ensure no circular deps: repositories should depend on lib/*, not the other way around.

Do-not-touch list (ABSOLUTE):
- app/src/lib/supabase.ts
- app/src/routing/**
- app/src/providers/**
- app/src/domain/training/** (if present)
- app/src/lib/training/** (if present)
- app/src/domain/insights/** (if present)
- app/src/lib/insights/** (if present)

If you find missing/extra repos/screens:
- If they belong to Mood/Meditation/Sleep/Meds: include them in the migration list and update them.
- If they belong to Training/Insights: list them in the final report as out-of-scope, but do NOT modify.

Verification checklist:
- Run the command stored in resolved_commands.typecheck
- Run the command stored in resolved_commands.test
- Smoke check: app loads; Mood, Meditation, Sleep, Meds screens still fetch and render.

Rollback plan:
- git revert <commit_sha>
- Or revert new files + restore previous imports in changed call sites.

Stop conditions:
- STOP if resolved_commands.typecheck or resolved_commands.test is null/empty.
- STOP if you are forced to change query keys, returned shapes, or add new runtime flows.
- STOP if migration spills into Training/Insights logic beyond listing files as out-of-scope.
verification: Run the command stored in resolved_commands.typecheck
Run the command stored in resolved_commands.test
rollback: Delete newly added files under app/src/persistence/** and app/src/data/repositories/** then restore prior imports in modified call sites

Avoid circular dependencies by making repositories depend on lib/* only, never the reverse.
AsyncStorage key compatibility is critical; StorageAdapter must preserve existing keys and value formats.
